# Paths where the old names may still appear, checked by scripts/check-old-name.sh.
# One entry per line: `<git pathspec>  # <reason>`. Lines starting with # are comments.
#
# Reasons:
#   money        "lukas"/"luka" is Colombian slang for money and stays (never the app or mascot name).
#   2b           infrastructure renamed in part 2b (deploy, database role and name, guest domain,
#                GitHub URLs, key and emulator labels).
#   2b: remove   transition code that carries the old name over; part 2b deletes it.
#   history      the plans and specs, which keep the names they were written with.
# A file holding more than one kind may list them comma-joined (`money, 2b`). Directory globs are
# only for whole folders that part 2b rewrites; everything else lists the files that have a hit.
# A file lists every reason for what remains in it.
